message.content: In the discussion regarding the bench press challenge, LiHua expresses enthusiasm and willingness to accept the proposal. She acknowledges her recent strength gains and agrees to the challenge, stating "I feel pretty strong lately, so yeah, I'm up for the challenge! Let's do it! 🏋️‍♂️". JenniferMoore is equally excited and encourages LiHua to ensure proper warming up, emphasizing, "Just make sure to warm up properly. You've got this! 🔥💥". LiHua confirms her commitment to preparation, saying, "Thanks for the encouragement! I’ll make sure to warm up and be ready. Looking forward to it! 🏆", indicating her positive attitude towards the upcoming challenge.
